fields.operationalization: Yes requires clinician synthesis of substantial aggression-related risk from clinician-reported fields: scenario-interval aggression observations plus lifetime aggression and treatment context, recorded at the current encounter with encounter/window attribution. A PANSS hostility item score alone never maps Yes. No requires a completed structured assessment finding no substantial aggression risk. Missing synthesis pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record (scenario-interval observations and lifetime context where applicable); copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.
